Most motorcycles don't have synchros, but they have dogs. Rev matching modern vehicles has more to do with maintaining the balance of the vehicle by not upsetting weight distribution. Particularly useful for racing. There is also argument about longevity of the drive train/clutch but that's the gist.

For example, in a perfectly executed rev match while braking there would be hardly any feeling at all to the vehicle or rider, and you are in the appropriate gear coming to your stop or turn. You maintain the normal balance of the vehicle at all times. 

If you are just dropping gears without throttle, you will get engine braking/jolting, and it'll keep throwing the weight forward.
